hero.title: Audio Instruments.
hero.subtitle: We engineer high-fidelity modular synthesizers and boutique audio processors. Designed to spark infinite creativity with absolute precision.

md01.title: Modular Architecture
md01.subtitle: Bespoke Patches & Signal Flows
md01.description: Infinite sonic canvas. Patch any CV (Control Voltage) or audio signal path, chain multi-stage modules, and shape your own customized acoustic layout.

hf02.title: High-Fidelity Audio
hf02.subtitle: Discrete Path & High Headroom
hf02.description: Burr-Brown operational amplifiers and discrete matched transistors providing exceptional +24dBu headroom, flat response, and an incredibly silent noise floor.

in03.title: Seamless Integration
in03.subtitle: Eurorack & MIDI Standards
in03.description: Full out-of-the-box compatibility with standard 1V/Oct Eurorack control voltage systems, MIDI-to-CV conversion modules, and global clock sync nodes.

about.title: Analog Soul. Digital Precision.
about.description: Noise & Waves is a custom boutique synthesizer workshop. We design and build modular hardware, high-fidelity devices, and signal processors that bridge the gap between vintage acoustic warmth and rock-solid modern performance.

warmth.title: Analog Warmth
warmth.subtitle: Custom Circuits & Soul
warmth.description: Discrete analog pathways, hand-tuned active filters, and custom wave-shaping circuitry that inject organic harmonics and analog weight into every frequency.

precision.title: Digital Precision
precision.subtitle: ARM DSP & Stable Clocks
precision.description: Cutting-edge ARM-based microcontrollers, ultra-low latency DAC/ADC converters, and high-frequency digital oscillators for precise modulation and reliable DSP control.

quality.title: Artisanal Quality
quality.subtitle: Hand-crafted in our Lab
quality.description: Every module is hand-soldered, features premium anodized aluminum control panels, high-grade knobs with tactile response, and undergoes rigorous signal testing.

contact.title: Connect With the Lab.
contact.description: Have questions about our modular synthesizer designs, need support with a module, or want to collaborate on a custom hardware project? Write us a message.

success.title: Message Transmitted
success.description: Your transmission has been received in our audio synthesis lab. We will respond within 48 hours.
